"Guerilla Open Access Manifesto" by Aaron Swartz

Unfortunately, nothing has changed since he published this. Phd's positions are still heavily competitive and they will cooperate with the major journals because they have to publish or perish. People say libraries are outdated, but they are the only infrastructure left that actually pays for this shit. Don't believe me? Go do some google searching right now about a scientific topic with peer reviewed results. You will be paying $50 an article if you don't have access to a library that can get it for you.

The problem is that most scientific studies are funded by public dollars, which are then published in private journals. So, in essence, these journals are receiving free content that they copyright and then charge the public for access. Businesses, doctors, etc, that rely on cutting edge research have no recourse other than to pay.
